decision_conditions: Condition : 1 - The development hereby permitted shall be begun before the expiration of three years from the date of this permission.

Condition : 2 - The proposed development shall be carried out in all respects in accordance with the proposals contained in the application and the plans submitted  therewith (1288.2.01, Design and Access Statement, and 6248 01, received on 20/11/2012, 1288.02 Rev A, received on 03/12/2012 and unnumbered location plan illustrating the location of the MOT dedicated car spaces, received on 08/01/2013) and approved by the Local Planning Authority, or as shall have been otherwise agreed in writing by the Local Planning Authority before the building is used.

Condition : 3 - No activity shall take place on site earlier than 7am or later than 7pm Monday to Friday and no earlier than 7am or later than 5pm on Saturday and not at all on Sundays and public holidays.
Condition : 4 - No works to vehicles shall be carried out other than within the building on the site and no refuse or discarded materials shall be stored other than within the building.

Condition : 5 - The parking spaces shown on the drawings hereby approved (unnumbered location plan, received on 08/01/2012) shall be kept available for the use of vehicles brought to the site for servicing testing and repairs or for staff parking and used for no other purpose
Condition : 6 - The fire exit in the rear of the premises shall remain shut unless an emergency requiring its use arises.
description: Change of use of existing vacant light industrial unit (Use class B1c) to form a vehicle service centre with provision for MOT testing (Use class B2). (note amended description)
